title: ICMAB CMA Qualification
body: The Institute of Cost and Management Accountants of Bangladesh
source: Cost and Management Accountants Act 2018 & 2021 Revised Syllabus
summary: ICMAB confers the ACMA and FCMA statutory chartered qualifications under the Cost and Management Accountants Act, 2018. Governs cost audit, enterprise management accounting, and strategic cost management across 2,000 marks across 5 progressive levels and 12 months practical articleship.

statutoryMonopoly.act: Cost and Management Accountants Act, 2018 (Act No. LXX of 2018)
primaryPowers: Exclusive statutory authority for Cost Audit under Companies Act 1994 Sec 220
Bangladesh Cost Accounting Standards (BCAS 1 to 31) standard-setting
Mandatory cost audit in pharmaceuticals, fertilizers, sugar, cement, textiles, power

standard.name: Standard Professional Track
standard.blurb: Complete all 5 levels (2,000 marks), 12 months articleship, and practical viva to earn ACMA.

stages.title: Level 1: Foundation Level
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) | Entry-level core business disciplines

nodes.name: Fundamentals of Financial Accounting
nodes.description: Double-entry bookkeeping, adjusting entries, bank reconciliation, trial balance, and financial statement preparation under IFRS/IAS.
topics: Double-Entry Bookkeeping & Accounting Equation Mechanics
Journal Entries, General Ledger & Trial Balance Preparation
Adjusting Entries, Accruals, Prepayments & Depreciation Methods
Bank Reconciliation Statements & Cash Control Systems
Financial Statements Preparation under IFRS for Sole Traders & Partnerships
Financial Accounting for Non-Profit Organizations & Incomplete Records

nodes.name: Business Quantitative Analysis
nodes.description: Time value of money, matrices, business calculus, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis.
topics: Time Value of Money, Compound Interest & Loan Amortization Schedules
Matrix Algebra, Determinants & Systems of Linear Equations (Cramer's Rule)
Differential & Integral Calculus for Business Revenue & Cost Optimization
Descriptive Statistics, Central Tendency & Dispersion Metrics
Probability Theory, Bayes' Theorem, Binomial, Poisson & Normal Distributions
Hypothesis Testing (z-tests, t-tests, Chi-square) & Simple Linear Regression

nodes.name: Business Economics & International Business
nodes.description: Microeconomic theory, macroeconomic indicators, fiscal/monetary policy, Bangladesh banking system, foreign trade, and BoP.
topics: Microeconomics: Demand-Supply Equilibrium, Elasticities & Consumer Utility
Production Functions, Law of Diminishing Returns & Economies of Scale
Market Structures: Perfect Competition, Monopoly, Oligopoly & Pricing
Macroeconomics: National Income Accounting (GDP, GNP) & Circular Flow
Monetary Policy, Fiscal Policy, Inflation & Bangladesh Bank Guidelines
International Trade: Comparative Advantage, Balance of Payments & WTO Rules

nodes.name: Fundamentals of Management & Business Communication
nodes.description: Organizational management principles, executive reporting, business communication, and professional ethical frameworks.
topics: Principles of Management, Planning & Modern Organizational Structures
Leadership Theories, Employee Motivation Models & Conflict Resolution
Corporate Communication Process, Barriers & Cross-Cultural Dynamics
Formal Corporate Drafting: Board Minutes, Executive Briefs & Business Reports
Oral Presentations, Persuasive Pitching & Boardroom Communication
Professional Ethics, Corporate Integrity & Codes of Professional Conduct

stages.title: Level 2: Intermediate Level I
stages.subtitle: 5 Papers (400 Marks) | Core operational costing, law, and corporate reporting

nodes.name: Cost Accounting
nodes.description: Cost concepts, material control, labor payroll schemes, overhead allocation under BCAS 4/5, job/contract/process costing.
topics: Cost Concepts, Classifications, Cost Objects & Cost Sheet Architecture
Direct Material Costing, EOQ, Inventory Valuation & BCAS 24 Compliance
Direct Labor Costing, Payroll Systems, Incentive Schemes & BCAS 25
Overhead Allocation, Apportionment & Absorption Rates under BCAS 4 & 5
Job Order Costing, Batch Costing & Contract Costing (BCAS 7 & 31)
Process Costing, Equivalent Units of Production & Joint/By-Product Costing (BCAS 8 & 9)

nodes.name: Intermediate Financial Accounting
nodes.description: IFRS 15 revenue, IFRS 16 leases, IAS 16 PPE, IAS 36 impairment, and comprehensive corporate financial statements.
topics: Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting & Qualitative Characteristics
Property, Plant and Equipment (IAS 16) & Impairment of Assets (IAS 36)
Intangible Assets (IAS 38) & Research/Development Capitalization
Revenue from Contracts with Customers (IFRS 15) 5-Step Recognition Model
Leases (IFRS 16): Lessee Right-of-Use Accounting & Lessor Classifications
Preparation of Corporate Financial Statements & Cash Flow Statements (IAS 7)

nodes.name: Information & Communication Technologies
nodes.description: DBMS architecture, SQL queries, ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), data analytics, cybersecurity, and internal IT controls.
topics: Computer Systems Architecture, Operating Systems & Server Virtualization
Relational Database Architecture, Normalization (1NF to 3NF) & SQL Queries
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Modules (SAP S/4HANA & Oracle Cloud)
Cloud Architectures (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) & Enterprise Data Warehousing
Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Cryptography (PKI) & Access Control Models
IT General Controls (ITGC), Application Controls & COBIT 2019 Framework

nodes.name: Marketing & Supply Chain Management
nodes.description: Marketing mix, STP framework, procurement lifecycle, logistics optimization, and supply chain risk mitigation.
topics: Customer Value Proposition, Marketing Mix (4Ps/7Ps) & Digital Marketing
Market Segmentation, Targeting & Positioning (STP Framework)
Supply Chain Architecture, Push vs. Pull Systems & Bullwhip Effect Mitigation
Strategic Procurement, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) & Vendor Evaluation
Logistics Network Design, Warehousing Operations & Reverse Logistics
Global Supply Chain Risk Management & Sustainable Sourcing Standards

nodes.name: Corporate & Business Laws
nodes.description: Companies Act 1994, Contract Act 1872, Negotiable Instruments 1881, and Bangladesh Labor Act 2006.
topics: Companies Act 1994: Company Types, Incorporation & Memorandum/Articles Alteration
Corporate Capital: Prospectus, Share Allotment, Transfers & Mortgages/Charges
Management & Administration: Directors' Duties, Board Meetings & AGMs/EGMs
Contract Act 1872: Essential Contract Elements, Consideration, Breach & Remedies
Sale of Goods Act 1930 & Negotiable Instruments Act 1881 (Cheque Dishonor Sec 138)
Bangladesh Labor Act 2006: Employment Conditions, Workplace Safety & Dispute Redress

stages.title: Level 3: Intermediate Level II
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) | Tactical management accounting, corporate finance & audit

nodes.name: Management Accounting
nodes.description: Marginal costing, CVP analysis, relevant cost decision-making, budgetary control, and standard costing variance analysis.
topics: Marginal Costing vs. Absorption Costing & Reconciliation of Income
Cost-Volume-Profit (CVP) Analysis, Multi-Product Break-Even & Margin of Safety
Short-Term Commercial Decision Making: Relevant Costs, Make-or-Buy & Special Orders
Strategic Pricing Models, Target Costing (BCAS 10) & Product Mix Decisions (BCAS 15)
Master Budget Preparation, Flexible Budgeting & Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB)
Standard Costing & Variance Analysis under BCAS 13 (Material, Labor, Overheads)

nodes.name: Financial Management
nodes.description: Financial ratio analysis, working capital optimization, DCF capital budgeting (NPV/IRR), and WACC capital structure theory.
topics: Financial Statement Analysis, Ratio Decomposition & DuPont 5-Factor Model
Working Capital Management: Cash Conversion Cycle, Receivables & Inventory Models
Capital Budgeting DCF Decision Models (NPV, IRR, MIRR, PI) under BCAS 21
Capital Budgeting under Risk: Sensitivity Analysis, Decision Trees & Real Options
Cost of Capital Estimation: WACC, CAPM Equity Pricing & After-Tax Cost of Debt
Capital Structure Theories (MM Propositions, Pecking Order) & Leverage Ratios

nodes.name: Auditing
nodes.description: Bangladesh Standards on Auditing (BSA/ISA), audit planning, internal control testing, substantive procedures, and audit opinions.
topics: Auditing Regulatory Framework, Professional Skepticism & IESBA Code of Ethics
Audit Planning, Risk Assessment Model & Materiality Determination (ISA 300, 315, 320)
Internal Control Evaluation, Test of Controls & Walk-Through Tests (ISA 330)
Audit Evidence Gathering, Substantive Testing & Analytical Procedures (ISA 500 & 520)
Audit Sampling Techniques, Tolerable Error & Misstatement Evaluation (ISA 530)
Audit Reporting: Audit Opinions, Key Audit Matters (KAM) & Emphasis of Matter (ISA 700 series)

nodes.name: Fundamentals of Tax, VAT & Public Financial Management
nodes.description: Income Tax Act 2023 heads of income, VAT & Supplementary Duty Act 2012, withholding VAT, and national budget PFM.
topics: Income Tax Act 2023: Residential Status, Total Income Scope & Assessee Rates
Heads of Income: Employment, Rent, Business Income, Capital Gains & Deductions
Corporate Tax Computation, Allowable Depreciation (3rd Schedule) & Minimum Tax
VAT & Supplementary Duty Act 2012: Registration, VAT Invoicing (Mushak 6.3) & Rates
Withholding Tax & VAT (VDS - Mushak 6.6) & Monthly VAT Return (Mushak 9.1)
Public Financial Management (PFM): National Budget Cycle & Public Procurement (PPA 2006)

stages.title: Level 4: Advanced Level I
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) | Strategic cost leadership, consolidated financial reporting & governance

nodes.name: Strategic Cost and Management Accounting
nodes.description: Activity-Based Management, target costing, life-cycle costing, Kaizen, TOC throughput accounting, quality costing (BCAS 29), transfer pricing.
topics: Strategic Cost Management Frameworks, Value Chain Analysis & BCAS 23 Alignment
Activity-Based Costing (ABC) & Activity-Based Management (ABM) under BCAS 14 & 20
Target Costing, Life Cycle Costing (LCC) & Kaizen Costing (BCAS 10, 11, 12)
Theory of Constraints (TOC), Bottleneck Optimization & Throughput Accounting
Cost of Quality (COQ) Analysis (BCAS 29), TQM & Environmental Cost Accounting
Divisional Performance Evaluation, Balanced Scorecard, EVA® & Transfer Pricing (BCAS 16)

nodes.name: Advanced Financial Reporting
nodes.description: Group consolidated accounts (IFRS 10/IFRS 3), financial instruments (IFRS 9), employee benefits (IAS 19), and ISSB sustainability standards.
topics: Business Combinations & Group Accounting under IFRS 3 & IFRS 10
Consolidated Financial Statements: Goodwill, Non-Controlling Interest & Eliminations
Accounting for Associates (IAS 28) & Joint Arrangements (IFRS 11)
Complex Financial Instruments Classification, Measurement & Hedging (IFRS 9)
Accounting for Income Taxes (IAS 12 Deferred Tax) & Employee Benefits (IAS 19)
Foreign Currency Operations Translation (IAS 21) & ISSB Sustainability Reporting (IFRS S1/S2)

nodes.name: Corporate Finance Strategy & Financial Market
nodes.description: M&A valuation, financial restructuring, IPO issuance, money and capital markets, and derivative risk hedging.
topics: Strategic Capital Structuring, Debt Covenant Optimization & Signaling Theory
Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Strategic Valuation (DCF, Multiples) & Deal Financing
Corporate Financial Restructuring, Divestitures, Spin-Offs & Distressed Debt Management
Money Market Instruments, Capital Markets & Bond Yield Curve Dynamics
Equity Financing Strategies: IPO Pricing (Book Building), Rights Issues & Private Equity
Financial Derivatives: Forwards, Futures, Swaps, Black-Scholes Options & Hedging

nodes.name: Corporate Governance & Secretarial Practices
nodes.description: OECD governance principles, BSEC Corporate Governance Code (CGC 2018), board secretarial procedures, and RJSC compliance.
topics: Corporate Governance Theories (Agency, Stakeholder) & International Frameworks
BSEC Corporate Governance Code (CGC 2018): Board Structure & Independent Directors
Board Committees Mandates: Audit Committee Charter & NRC Compliance
Corporate Secretarial Practice: Board Meetings, Agendas, Minutes & Resolutions
Organizing AGMs/EGMs, Shareholder Voting Systems & RJSC Statutory Returns
Corporate Governance Reporting, Whistleblowing Policies & Compliance Certification

stages.title: Level 5: Advanced Level II & Practicum
stages.subtitle: 4 Papers (400 Marks) + 12-Month Articleship | Statutory cost audit, enterprise strategy & case study

nodes.name: Business Strategy
nodes.description: Strategic environmental scanning (PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces), competitive positioning, strategic execution, and turnaround.
topics: Strategic Management Process, Vision, Mission & Strategic Intent Formulation
External Industry Analysis: PESTEL Framework & Porter's Five Forces Model
Internal Strategic Appraisal: Resource-Based View (RBV), VRIO & Value Chain
Business Competitive Strategies: Porter's Generic Strategies & Blue Ocean Paradigm
Corporate Portfolio Strategies (BCG Matrix, Ansoff Grid), M&A & Strategic Alliances
Strategy Execution, Organizational Architecture, Balanced Scorecard & Change Management

nodes.name: Cost & Management Audit
nodes.description: Statutory cost audit execution under Companies Act 1994 Sec 220, Cost Audit Rules 1997, BCAS compliance, and statutory reporting.
topics: Statutory Cost Audit Legal Framework: Companies Act 1994 Sec 220 & Cost Audit Rules 1997
Mandatory Cost Audit Gazette Directives: Pharmaceuticals, Fertilizers, Cement & Textiles
Application of Bangladesh Cost Accounting Standards (BCAS 1–31) in Audit Engagements
Cost Audit Planning, Manufacturing Overhead Verification & Capacity Audits (BCAS 28)
Drafting Statutory Cost Audit Reports, Annexures & Submissions to Ministry of Commerce
Management Audit, Operational Audit, Efficiency Evaluation & Energy/Environmental Audits

nodes.name: Advanced Income Tax & VAT
nodes.description: Corporate tax planning, transfer pricing regulations, international tax treaties (DTAA), VAT tribunal disputes, and ADR.
topics: Corporate Tax Computation for Public, Private, Banking & Export Entities under ITA 2023
International Tax Treaties (DTAA), Foreign Tax Credits & Permanent Establishment Rules
Transfer Pricing Regulations: Arm's Length Principle, Pricing Methods & CbC Reporting
Tax Assessments, Scrutiny, Appeals (Taxes Appellate Tribunal) & High Court References
Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) under Income Tax & VAT Legislation
Advanced VAT Adjudications, Large Taxpayer Unit (LTU) Compliance & Tax Planning Ethics

nodes.name: Integrated Case Study
nodes.description: Capstone integrative case evaluating strategic cost leadership, corporate finance, enterprise risk, ethics, and board governance.
topics: Multi-Disciplinary Corporate Case Synthesis across Strategy, Costing, Finance & Tax
Strategic Cost & Profitability Diagnostics using ABC, Target Costing & Throughput Models
Financial Restructuring Evaluation, Valuation Modeling & Cash Flow Projections
Corporate Governance, Ethical Board Conduct & Statutory Cost Audit Integration
Formulating Board-Level Strategic Action Plans & Presentation-Grade Executive Briefs

nodes.name: CMA Practical Articleship (12 Months)
nodes.description: 12 months mandatory supervised practical training in an approved CMA firm or recognized corporate organization under an ACMA/FCMA.
topics: 12 Months Practical Articleship under Active ACMA/FCMA Supervision
Practical Exposure to Enterprise Cost Accounting & BCAS Implementation
Participation in Statutory Cost Audit Engagements & Workpaper Preparation
Corporate Budgeting, Management Reporting & Variance Tracking in Industry
Verification of Mandatory Experience Logbook & Articleship Completion Certificate

fast-track-icab.name: ICAB Qualified Fast-Track Pathway
fast-track-icab.blurb: Receive broad exemptions from Foundation and Business levels; focus on specialized Cost Accounting and statutory Cost Audit papers.

stages.subtitle: Waiver from Foundation Level and standard financial reporting papers

nodes.name: Credit for Prior Learning Sign-Off
nodes.description: Verification of active ACA/FCA membership with ICAB. Grants paper waivers across Foundation and select financial accounting papers.

nodes.description: CA articleship completed at an approved ICAB CA firm satisfies the practical experience requirement for ACMA admission.

nodes.name: Admission as ACMA
nodes.description: Conferral of the Associate Cost and Management Accountant (ACMA) designation and issuance of membership certificate.

fast-track-acca.name: ACCA Qualified Fast-Track Pathway
fast-track-acca.blurb: Receive 4 Business Level subject exemptions + Foundation waivers; complete local law, tax, and Cost & Management Audit.

stages.title: Stage 1: ACCA Exemption Recognition
stages.subtitle: Foundation level waiver and paper-to-paper exemptions

nodes.name: ACCA Membership Exemption Verification
nodes.description: Submission of ACCA member transcript or affiliate certificate. Exemptions granted across Foundation and standard reporting papers.
